page.layout: One column of running text, with Syriac verse lines set in full-width blocks between Latin paragraphs. Latin translations of the Syriac in italic follow each block. No margin notes. Page number at the head.

main_text.p: tris electis sunt confirmata, & posita fundamenta.
Præcones Spiritus sancti. Ibidem paulo inferius:

p.i: In Ecclesia Sanctitatis prædicatur fides illa, quam prædicarunt nobis sancti Præcones Spi-ritus sancti Basilius, cum magno Gregorio, & Ioanne Chrysostomo.

main_text.p: Athletæ feruidi veritatis, & Milites vi-ctores contra errorem. Ibidem:

p.i: Athleta feruidi veritatis, & milites victores sint[?] Basilius, cum magno Gregorio in certamine contra errorem.

page.notes: The Syriac lines (five, five-to-four, and two blocks) are printed in Syriac script and cannot be read reliably at this resolution, so they are marked illegible with estimated letter counts. The Latin italic translations and roman text are transcribed. Long s is rendered as plain s, so "Bafilius" is given as Basilius and "fanctis" as sanctis. "fint" in the second italic note is read as sint[?] and is doubtful. No running head is printed on this page.
